settings.scope: Separate static qualification before time integration; original root, thermochemical and physical definitions preserved. No true-material parameter fitting.
settings.reason: Carbon coordinate changes from mol to log(C/Ca): transfer the existing 1e-6 mol/s rate normalization to log-rate units by dividing it by nominal C, just as density perturbations are divided by C. The first log-chart review omitted this row-unit conversion and is retained. Physical normalizations and 1e-5 scaled derivative budget are unchanged.

numerics.absolute_tolerance_basis: Dimensionless absolute errors in log(C/Ca) and log(N/Nref); energy scales with actual volume. Relative tolerance and exterior ledger tolerances unchanged.
numerics.initial_step_reason: Chosen before graded trajectories to resolve the much smaller boundary-cell thermal time; the original uniform step was 1e-5s. No change to physical equations, end time, relative precision or acceptance targets.

column_parameters.classification: Prescribed virtual gas and radiation reservoirs; equilibrium reaction limit with physically separate inner/outer ledgers
column_parameters.boundary_change_interpretation: Switch contacts to distinct prescribed reservoirs at 4000s; no instantaneous change of cell inventory or internal energy. No model of the energy required to condition the external reservoirs.
column_parameters.scope: One-dimensional conditional equilibrium reaction and shared gas/energy transport. No actual brick material accuracy or finite-rate chemistry.

domain.geometry_classification: Virtual 2cm fixed-volume planar column, sealed left and one open right surface.

transport.classification: declared virtual positive symmetric gas exchange, not calibrated Darcy or binary diffusivity
transport.source_note: No material measurement; Onsager supplies near-equilibrium response structure only; finite force use is an explicit constitutive extension.

column_parameters.state_order: Per-cell [ln(C/Ca), ln(N2/Nref), U], followed by original ten exterior ledgers
column_parameters.surface_geometry: Explicit nonuniform planar widths; internal distances are half the sum of neighboring widths, boundary distance is half the last width. All inventories use actual cell volumes. The nitrogen reference inventory remains the average-cell coordinate scale only.
column_parameters.extended_program_reason: The geometry-matched one-cell 8000s reference completed and agreed with the column assembly, but did not yet cross the separately declared mean-500K cooling event. Preserve that complete record and extend the cooling phase to 12000s before any multi-cell spatial trajectory; physical coefficients and all event/accuracy thresholds are unchanged.
column_parameters.revision_basis: Both original 48-cell runs failed near 4.65s when an implicit offset trial made total C negative. Use C=Ca*exp(zC) and offset=Ca*expm1(zC) together: positive total C and resolved trace excess at C near Ca, without clipping or a gas floor.

geometry_source.locator: Transient term Eq1, diffusion gradient and face conductance D_f=A_f Gamma_f/d_AP
geometry_source.classification: numerical discretization source; not a source of material conductivity, mobility, or brick geometry

radiation.area_classification: Same declared zero-storage contact area, not the earlier capsule geometry.

source.numerical_representation: Finite printed digits retained, not an exact decimal; not material uncertainty.

radiation.entropy_scope: Combined material plus prescribed thermal reservoir, neglect radiation-field storage; Q/Twall is reservoir entropy loss, not a claim that photon entropy flux equals Q/Twall.
